ztz99_longwei.silhouette: Original Chinese ZTZ-99-lineage game concept (release 262). A new 99A-pattern hull: a pointed nose where a 21.9 degree upper glacis meets a 52 degree lower glacis carrying a straight FY-5 grid and four appliqué boxes, sponsons to 1.70 m a side sloped behind the fender boxes, a 1.50 m roof and 1.78 m powerpack deck, an inclined rear plate with a slatted access grille, lamps, tow hooks and a stern rack with its bin, six road wheels behind eight segmented skirt panels scalloped over each wheel with one FY-5 course on the front three. An arrowhead turret of two welded wedges swept 37 degrees off square to the side modules, two large dual-reactive modules a face, a slim cast mantlet in a canvas boot, fanned smoke banks on the wedges' outer faces, the commander's panoramic sight and QJC-88 right of the gun, the gunner's sight and the LSDW pedestal on the left, two lidded bins, a 0.62 m rear basket and the GL-5-style protection suite.
